build_SparseResBlock3d: build a SparseResBlock3d with 3D sparse convolutions, normalization, and optional downsampling or upsampling
build_SLatFlowModel: build an SLatFlowModel with sparse transformer blocks, input/output ResBlocks, and timestep embedding for 3D diffusion
build_SLatFlowModelTdfyWrapper: build an SLatFlowModelTdfyWrapper that wraps SLatFlowModel with condition embedding and sparse tensor conversion
test_SLatFlowModel_forward: test the SLatFlowModel forward pass with sparse tensor input, timestep, and condition embeddings
test_SLatFlowModelTdfyWrapper_forward: test the SLatFlowModelTdfyWrapper forward pass with dense tensor input, coords, and condition arguments
